author: Cobalt_Viper
what_it_is: All skins & characters Unlocked, 60 seconds high score 91.
format: PSP save folder, 4 files in the folder ULUS10002LUMINES/: PARAM.SFO (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY ULUS10002LUMINES, TITLE LUMINES, SAVEDATA_FILE_LIST names DATA.BIN with its hash), DATA.BIN 18464 bytes (encrypted by the system's savedata call), ICON0.PNG, PIC1.PNG

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psp-savedata.py memstick <zip> <memory stick>: writes the zip's files, unchanged, to PSP/SAVEDATA/<SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY>/ (the name read from PARAM.SFO)

ppsspp.frontend: tools/retro-run --pace 60 (PPSSPP emulates in real time on its own thread), OpenGL 4.1 core context, options scripts/psp/ppsspp-auto.opt; memory stick = the save directory (PSP/SAVEDATA/), PPSSPP assets in <system>/PPSSPP; image read from a local copy
ppsspp.detail: main menu after title: the log-in character 'PETER' with its avatar in the top right corner; baseline (no save): the second START opens 'LOG-IN: Create log-in character' (and the game writes a fresh ULUS10002LUMINES)

ppsspp@ppsspp.frontend: PPSSPPSDL.app with HOME in the work folder (memory stick .config/ppsspp), software renderer (Vulkan output), driven over the debugger WebSocket; the frame is the PSP framebuffer read from VRAM (memory.read 0x04000000, 480x272, stride 512, 8888) because gpu.buffer.screenshot fails here
ppsspp@ppsspp.detail: main menu after title: the log-in character 'PETER' with its avatar in the top right corner; baseline (no save): the second START opens 'LOG-IN: Create log-in character' (and the game writes a fresh ULUS10002LUMINES); PSP RAM at the menu holds 'PETER' as well

note: Mislabelled section: posted under Europe, but the save is for the USA release (ULUS10002).
